definitions.explanation: A formal expression of joy and congratulation for a happy occasion, particularly events of national or institutional significance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦{即位|そくい}→即位：11974_sokui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{慶祝|けいしゅく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{創立|そうりつ}→創立：15353_souritsu⟧⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦{周年|しゅうねん}→周年：09520_shuunen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{慶祝|けいしゅく}⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Celebratory events for the 100th anniversary of the founding were held.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧こぞって⟦{新|あら}た→新た：01697_arata⟧な⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{幕開|まくあ}け→幕開け：16042_makuake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{慶祝|けいしゅく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The entire nation celebrated the dawn of a new era.

notes:
Composed of {慶|けい} (joy, congratulation) + {祝|しゅく} (celebration). A very formal word used primarily in ceremonial and official contexts. It carries a weight and solemnity not found in everyday words for celebration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {慶祝|けいしゅく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to celebrate formally
- {慶祝|けいしゅく}⟦{行事|ぎょうじ}→行事：00078_gyouji⟧ — celebratory event
- {慶祝|けいしゅく}⟦{式典|しきてん}→式典：09526_shikiten⟧ — celebratory ceremony
- {慶祝|けいしゅく}⟦ムード→ムード：11160_muudo⟧ — festive/celebratory mood

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{祝賀|しゅくが}→祝賀：14770_shukuga⟧ — celebration, congratulation; formal but slightly more common than {慶祝|けいしゅく}
- ⟦お{祝|いわ}い→お祝い：01339_oiwai⟧ — celebration, congratulation; the everyday word
- ⟦{祝福|しゅくふく}→祝福：13733_shukufuku⟧ — blessing, well-wishes; more personal and warm
